sql: SELECT j.jobid, j.jobname, j.schedule, j.active, substring(j.command from 'functions/v1/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)') AS fn, CASE WHEN j.command ILIKE '%functions/v1/%' THEN NULL ELSE left(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(j.command, 'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '<jwt>', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 200) END AS cmd FROM cron.job j ORDER BY j.jobname
